info.name: ERPNext REST API
info.description:
Koleksi REST API ERPNext (Frappe) - satu file untuk SEMUA modul.
Saat ini berisi: OAuth 2.0 + Supplier + Customer + Contact + Address + Lead + Employee + User + Warehouse + POS Profile + Item Group + Stock Reconciliation. Modul lain (Buying, Selling, dst.) ditambahkan sebagai folder baru. Folder 14 = Pricing Rule (diskon/promo); folder 15 = Price List & Item Price (harga produk).

Autentikasi: OAuth 2.0 (Authorization Code + Refresh Token) - dikonfigurasi di level collection, otomatis dipakai semua folder.

Variabel yang perlu diisi:
- base_url        : alamat site, mis. https://erpnext.localhost
- client_id       : dari Integrations > OAuth Client
- client_secret   : dari Integrations > OAuth Client
- callback_url    : redirect URI OAuth
- supplier_id     : name Supplier hasil CREATE (mis. SUP-00001)
- customer_id     : name Customer hasil CREATE (mis. CUST-00001)
- lead_id         : name Lead hasil CREATE (mis. CRM-LEAD-00001)
- employee_id     : name Employee hasil CREATE (mis. HR-EMP-00001)
- contact_name    : name Contact hasil CREATE (mis. Markus)
- address_id      : name Address hasil CREATE (mis. PT Maju Jaya-Billing)
- user_id         : name User hasil CREATE (= email, mis. budi@perusahaan.co.id)
- warehouse_id    : name Warehouse hasil CREATE (mis. Gudang Raw Material - PTMJ)
- warehouse_name  : warehouse_name utk pre-check duplikat
- warehouse_type_name : name Warehouse Type (mis. Store)
- pos_profile_id    : name POS Profile hasil CREATE (mis. POS Toko Cikarang)
- pos_profile_name  : label POS Profile utk pre-check duplikat
- tax_servis_template     : title template pajak servis saja (title = 'Servis 10%'; name otomatis = 'Servis 10% - APS')
- tax_servis_ppn_template : title template pajak servis + PPN (title = 'Servis + PPN 11% (dasar termasuk servis)'; name otomatis = '... - APS')
- tax_tip_template       : title template biaya Tip (title = 'Tip 5%'; name otomatis = 'Tip 5% - APS')
- tax_surcharge_template : title template Employee Surcharge (title = 'Employee Surcharge 3%'; name otomatis = '... - APS')
- tax_servis_tip_ppn_template : title template Servis + Tip + PPN (title = 'Servis + Tip + PPN 11%'; name otomatis = '... - APS')
- item_group_id     : name Item Group hasil CREATE (mis. Minuman)
- item_group_name   : item_group_name utk pre-check duplikat
- item_group_parent : parent group node (mis. Food & Beverage)
- item_group_child  : leaf baru di bawah group (mis. Air Mineral)
- item_code         : Item yg dipindah ke leaf baru (mis. Air Mineral 600ml)
- item_tax_template : template pajak utk child taxes (mis. PPN 11% - PTMJ)
- stock_reco_id        : name Stock Reconciliation hasil CREATE (mis. MAT-RECO-00001-2026)
- stock_reco_company   : company utk SR (mis. PT Maju Jaya)
- stock_reco_warehouse : warehouse utk baris items SR (mis. Toko Cikarang - PTMJ)
- stock_reco_item      : item_code yg disesuaikan (mis. Air Mineral 600ml)
- stock_reco_posting_date / stock_reco_posting_time : tanggal & jam posting SR
- stock_adjustment_account : akun selisih / Difference Account (mis. Stock Adjustment - PTMJ)
- price_list_name    : name Price List hasil CREATE (mis. Grosir; name = price_list_name)
- price_list_name_2  : Price List kedua untuk uji (mis. Internal Transfer)
- item_price_id      : name Item Price hasil CREATE (hash 10 karakter, mis. h6o7fl78so)
- item_price_id_2    : name Item Price kedua (mis. harga khusus customer)
- item_price_rate    : nilai harga uji untuk set_value/save (mis. 13500)

Cara pakai:
1. Isi variabel di atas (Collection Variables).
2. Tab Authorization pada request mana pun > Get New Access Token (alur OAuth2 sudah dikonfigurasi), atau jalankan folder "0. OAuth 2.0".
3. Jalankan request pada folder modul yang diinginkan.
